links.outcome: Reading grade level of original patient-facing craniofacial education materials versus recommended maximum
links.effect: Original excerpts averaged grade level 10.79, significantly greater than the recommended maximum of 8 (P < 0.001; 95% CI, 2.51–3.38).
links.quote: The original excerpts had an average grade level score of 10.79, which was significantly greater than the maximum national recommended grade level of 8 ( P < 0.001; 95% CI, 2.51–3.38).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-simplified patient education text versus originals
links.effect: Simplified excerpts mean grade level 7.78 by calculator (7.69 by ChatGPT), significantly lower than originals (P < 0.001) and below the recommended maximum of 8.
links.quote: The mean grade level for the simplified excerpts with the traditional readability calculator was 7.78.
